sentences.text: A UCB shall clearly disclose whether pre-payment charges apply in the sanction letter and loan agreement.
Where a KFS is required for the loan, the same disclosure shall also be mentioned in the KFS.
A UCB shall not charge any pre-payment charges that have not been disclosed as specified.
The pre-payment charge rules also state that, outside the specified categories, any pre-payment charges are as per the approved policy of the UCB.
